text: The Patriots are riding genuine momentum heading into Week 5 against the Raiders after Drake Maye's three-touchdown performance earned him AFC Offensive Player of the Week honors in last Sunday's thrilling 29-26 comeback victory over Buffalo—a win that propelled New England from 1-3 to 2-2 and helped the team join the Rams and Cowboys as architects of Week 4's most stunning rallies. The looming challenge at Gillette Stadium involves navigating the Raiders' formidable tight end duo of Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer after the Patriots successfully shut down Buffalo's red-hot Dalton Kincaid, though they'll need to do so while managing a significant question mark at running back with Rhamondre Stevenson nursing an injury that leaves the backfield in flux. Beyond the roster concerns, the Patriots will sport throwback uniforms for Week 5, joining the Packers' debut of their new Rivalries look in what promises to be a visually distinctive matchup that could set the tone for whether this team's sudden resurgence represents genuine course correction or an overreaction soon to be tempered by reality.
